name: codex-jev
description: One Jev switch for line-by-line filtering of supported local tool output.

interface.longDescription: Codex Jev adds one local PostToolUse filter for supported plain-text tool results. One session switch controls all output. A Rust hook asks TypeSafe AI’s Jev to classify a sampled excerpt, then packs API-bounded requests for independent line relevance judgments when the output can be shortened. Code protects diagnostics and exact evidence. Failed or unsupported results remain intact. Every shortened result points to a private, exact original. The standalone hook requires explicit enablement and a TypeSafe API key. The optional VS Code control enables Jev for new local threads and provides one on/off button. The control and version-pinned composer patch are installed separately. This package contains a Linux x86_64 hook binary; other execution environments need their own native binary.
defaultPrompt: Help me set up Codex Jev for test logs.
Check whether this Jev-shortened result kept the evidence I need.
